info.title: Vaultor API
info.description: Personal workspace with local owner access and opt-in host-approved LAN HTTPS. No accounts, master passwords or encrypted archives. See docs/security/HOST-ACCESS.md. Resource lifecycle protocol 3; workspace archives 3. Trash preserves originals; legacy destructive routes return 405. 0.6.0 adds category-filtered paging, saved-reference pages and bounded PNG thumbnails without a protocol/schema migration. 0.8.0 adds bounded isolated host workspaces with optional X-Vaultor-Workspace selection; missing scope always means the fixed legacy workspace. API protocol3/archive3 remain unchanged. 0.9.0 exposes owner grant inspection for client workspace selectors; scope and protocol remain unchanged. 0.10.0 adds owner-only staged import-as-new and native snapshot forks; protocol3/archive3 unchanged. 0.11.0 adds companion checkpoint schema1: immutable hashed inventory/payloads and bounded range resume; protocol3/archive3 unchanged. Android offline storage follows separately. 0.12.0 adds workspace-scoped review evidence/status (reviews:1). API protocol3 remains compatible; workspace archive4 includes portable reviews and rejects unsupported versions. Android alpha.11 remains compatible; capture/sync follows in R6. 0.15.0 adds collectedImports:1, bounded host text/Markdown conversion and immutable receipts, original-byte provenance in archive5, and paired-device ZIP proposals with separate local-owner inspection/authorization. Protocol3 remains compatible; readers of archive4 or below reject new archive5 packages. 0.18.0 adds collection hierarchy and guarded folder-import relationship finalization. Flat full/partial exports retain schemas 5/6; hierarchy-bearing exports use 7/8. Nested offline companion checkpoints are refused until a hierarchy-aware mobile client exists.

get.summary: Search saved resource titles and structured note text
get.description: Literal prefix search over saved note text, resource titles and asynchronously extracted supported PDF/UTF-8 file text. Title weight 10, body 1; deterministic title/ID ties. fileCoverage counts the selected type/category/collection/tag/pin scope independently of query matches. Partial coverage does not broaden scope. PDF 20 MiB/100 pages, UTF-8 text 4 MiB, 500000 UTF-16 units, 15 seconds/128 MiB subprocess heap; encrypted/invalid/unsupported files are reported. No OCR, remote fetching or code execution.
